1.name: same_day
messages: You already showed up today. That's the whole game.
Done for the day. Rest up - tomorrow's session is ready when you are.
Nothing left to do but recover. See you tomorrow.

2.name: next_day_on_track
messages: Right on schedule. Your session is ready.
Back again. That's how streaks are built.
New day, same commitment. Let's go.
You showed up yesterday. You're showing up today. That's the pattern.
Consistency looks good on you. Here's today's session.

3.name: missed_one
messages: You missed one. It happens. What matters is you're here now.
One day off doesn't erase what you've built. Pick it back up.
Yesterday didn't happen. Today can. Your session is ready.
Missed a day? Doesn't matter. You came back. That's the move.
The streak broke. The habit didn't. Let's go.
One miss doesn't make a pattern. Showing up today does.

4.name: missed_a_few
messages: It's been {duration}. No judgment - just a session waiting for you.
You've been away {duration}. The plan didn't go anywhere. Neither did your progress.
A few days off. It happens to everyone. Your next session is ready.
{duration} since your last session. Let's not make it longer.
Been a minute. Your body remembers more than you think. Let's go.

5.name: extended_absence
messages: It's been {days} days. You're here now. That's what counts.
{duration} is a long time. But you opened the app. That's step one.
Welcome back. {days} days away, but you didn't delete the app. That says something.
It's been {duration}. No lectures. Just your next session, whenever you're ready.
You came back after {days} days. Most people don't. Let's rebuild.

time_of_day.early_morning: Good timing. Morning sessions hit different.
time_of_day.morning: Still early. Plenty of time to get it done.
time_of_day.afternoon: Half the day left. Your session is waiting.
time_of_day.evening: Evening session? Some of the best work happens now.
time_of_day.night: Planning for tomorrow? Smart. Your session is set.

session_complete: That's {total} sessions total. You're a regular now.
Day {streak}. They can't take this from you.
Done. One more brick in the wall.
Checked in. The compound effect is working.
celebrations.streak_14: Two weeks. This is becoming who you are.
celebrations.streak_30: 30 days. You're not the same person who started.
